metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene first aid kits for your business. Durable, waterproof cases ideal for job sites. Get your quote today.
introHtml: Poly propylene first aid kits offer a durable, lightweight, and waterproof solution compared to traditional vinyl or nylon kits. The rigid material protects contents from moisture and impact, making them ideal for construction sites, warehouses, and outdoor work crews. Custom imprint your company logo on the smooth surface for clear visibility. Choose from compact personal kits or larger group sizes to match your safety plan.
